$comment: CODM screen types for gating (W0). Data only: g1_scan analyse does not apply the gate yet (the W2 screen classifier will). A detector may run only on the screens in its `screens` list, and each screen lists the same detectors (the validator checks both sides). Cue ROIs are fractions of the game area. Values come from the A5-A5c evidence only; anything not measured there is status unverified with a note. modes [] = not tied to a match mode. DMZ is tag-only: no screen runs a detector for it.

screens.name: MP gameplay HUD

cues.note: HUD words of the g1_scan frame classifier (MODE_CUES mp), anywhere on the frame. The word set agreed with the visual mode label on 77/79 MP corpus clips (A5 §4); single words are not measured. KILLCAM is in this set, so BR KILL CAM frames classify as mp (A5c).

screens.note: Includes MP killcams (N1 label_mp, killer_header, killer_card). Without a mode gate B1 fired 409 boxes on MP frames (A5c), so B1 is not allowed here.

screens.name: BR gameplay HUD

cues.note: HUD words of the g1_scan frame classifier (MODE_CUES br), anywhere on the frame. The word set agreed with the visual mode label on 28/32 BR corpus clips (A5 §4); single words are not measured.

screens.note: Includes the BR death sequence (HELP ME, KILL CAM, Waiting for Revival Flight; A5b §3). Without a mode gate M5 fired 889 boxes on BR frames (A5c), so M5 is not allowed here. M3 is MP-only: on BR frames it matched the Nuclear Plant map label and a loading tip (A5c).

screens.name: Lobby and menus
screens.note: Between matches (A5c: MP lobby after the summary screen; BR lobby 00:00-00:13 with a Resurgence playlist). No cue text or position is measured. The IGN also appears in lobby toasts and room messages (A5 §5), so no detector runs here.

screens.name: Player Profile pages
screens.note: End of BR capture 2, 13:00-15:15 (A5b §4): basic page, game card, MP/BR/DMZ/Zombies stats, achievements, medals, match history and match details. Cue text and positions are not recorded. The pages show the IGN, a clan line, a UID and MVP-like text: M1 misfired on profile/history pages (A5b §3) and the 12 BR reference-medal crops came from the medal pages (A5b §5).

screens.name: Like toast

cues.note: Toast with a player name and an MVP tag. y 0.28-0.31 in A5b and A5c (MP 00:14-00:15, BR 05:47-05:49), y 0.28-0.38 on the corpus (A5). x extent not measured, so the box is full width.

screens.note: Shown over the lobby and end screens. Boxes inside it count for no detector: M1 misfired on its MVP tag and B1 on the name in it (A5c BR 05:47-05:49).

screens.name: Match result (VICTORY / DEFEAT)
screens.note: 2026-11-07 practice (game area of the H canvas, 0.5 fps): one large result word, centre, about 2-4 s, at the end of each MP match. VICTORY at 358 s (x 0.416-0.584, y 0.372-0.476), DEFEAT at 942-944 s (x 0.417-0.582, y 0.371-0.477). Followed by the scoreboard, where a smaller VICTORY sits at the top (y < 0.11).

screens.name: Match summary

cues.note: MP header: the mode name top centre (x 0.508-0.636, y 0.020-0.057), the map name under it, the result word left of it, then the team cards (KILLS n, MVP) and PLAY AGAIN / EXIT. 2026-11-09 practice, 5-s sweep: 390-395, 1140-1145, 1695-1705, 2440, 2815 s (5 of 6 match ends; none after the Control match at 3112 s). docs/evidence/2026-11-10-lobby-mode-and-kill-dedup.md.

screens.note: After the XP screen (A5c: MP 00:17, 06:34, 16:44-16:45; BR 05:55-05:58). It shows MVP badges for both teams while the IGN is elsewhere on the frame, so a frame-level name check would make the A5c m2 defeat positive: no name-reading detector runs here. Only name-free context detectors may (tools/game-validate.mjs): C2 reads the mode name in the header (2026-11-10, user approved).

screens.name: Post-match MVP screen

cues.note: A5b: MVP at x 0.02-0.11, y 0.41-0.47; the name sits right of and below it (x 0.11-0.33, y 0.47-0.55) and slides in from the left.

screens.note: One player per screen. Seen 2/2 in A5b; A5c m1 (IGN) and m2 (another player).

screens.name: Impact Play replay

cues.note: Header top centre: 8/8 on the corpus (A5), 10/10 live (A5b).

screens.note: Post-match replay of the best sequence (about 22 s) with a REC marker (position not measured). The replay repeats the match medals and +N popups: M3 and M4 run here and are suppressed (suppressionRules suppress_medals_in_replay). Whether kill-feed (M5) or multi-kill (X1) text repeats in the replay is not measured (UNVERIFIED), so they are left out.

screens.name: FINAL KILLCAM

cues.note: Seen in 1 corpus clip / 5 frames (A5); not in any live capture (A5b, A5c).

screens.note: Match-ending kill replay; never an N1 death. Capture-plan items final_killcam_ign and final_killcam_other.

screens.name: MP scoreboard

cues.note: One MVP badge per team: own team y 0.65, enemy y 0.84 (A5b); x not measured. The box is the M1 endscreen_row band, verified on corpus crops (A5).

screens.note: A final MP scoreboard frame is still missing (capture-plan mp_final_scoreboard). Scoreboards were read during play in A5c (03:36, 12:49, 14:20, 14:43); whether those show MVP badges is not recorded (UNVERIFIED). S1 (2026-11-08) reads the own row's kills here; its ROI and kills header are unverified until a frame exists.

screens.name: MP top 3

cues.note: MVP badge at y 0.84-0.87 under the card (A5, A5b); x depends on the card, so the box is full width.

screens.note: After an ad of about 4 s that follows the end screens (A5c). A5b: IGN read 7/7, small MVP badge 1/7 with the crop profile (read by the full-frame pass). 2026-11-08 practice (H canvas, project layout): three cards, rank 1 centre, rank 2 left, rank 3 right, each with SCORE n, VICTORY at the top, mode and map top left, a 15 s countdown top right; S1 reads rank, score and the own card. The team shown (own team only, or the winners) is not checked (UNVERIFIED; one VICTORY match seen).

screens.name: BR squad cards

cues.note: Badge at y 0.78-0.80 under the MVP's avatar, name at y 0.81-0.82 (A5, A5b); x depends on the card.
KILLS 0 / KILLS 1 and MVP read 6/6 on A5c crops; position not measured.

screens.note: M1 runs in MP only (P2a gate §6 risk), so no detector runs here yet. Adding M1 needs br in M1 modes and this screen in its gate (user decision). A5b: badge on a teammate; A5c: badge on the user (duo).

screens.name: BR placement / GAME OVER

cues.note: A5c: GAME OVER #48/50 at ~05:37, squad cards #48/50 05:43-05:50. A5b: Resurgence win #1/10. Position not measured.

screens.note: No BR end-screen detector yet; a BR win is still missing (capture-plan br_win). The GAME OVER screen also shows KILLCAM text (N1 misfire, A5c).

screens.name: Capture-card No Signal

cues.note: Capture-card screen on 15/180 sampled corpus frames in 5 sessions (A5 §4, labelled by eye, not OCR). Position not measured.

screens.note: Signal loss during recording, not a detector issue; the clipper skips it.

pairingRules.note: End screens carry MVP badges for every MVP (both teams, teammates), so a badge counts only with the profile name on the same card, right of or below the badge (post-match: name x 0.11-0.33, y 0.47-0.55; scoreboard: the badge's own row; top 3: the card above the badge). A name elsewhere on the frame never pairs (A5c summary screens). Described in A5b and A5c, not implemented in g1_scan (UNVERIFIED). BR squad cards use the same layout (name y 0.81-0.82 under the badge), but M1 does not run in BR yet.
